At HAAS Alert, you’ll be part of a team working towards a shared vision of a safer and more connected future. You’ll do meaningful work in a fast-paced environment built for growth, transformation, and impact.

### Employee benefits

Hybrid working

With two days a week in our Lincoln Park, Chicago office, you’ll find a balance between building in-person connections and working remotely.

Unlimited DTO

HAAS Alert offers employees an unlimited Discretionary Time Off structure, giving you freedom to manage your work and life.

Health & wellbeing

Your well being matters. That’s why we offer health, dental, and vision insurance, along with access to confidential counseling.
